26. The west re-entrant of Wang Cheong House was connected to the lift lobbies via windows on each floor, as shown in Photos 1(a) and 1(b), with the upper part of the windows being openable. The rapid fire spread along the west re-entrant was observed at 1511 hours. Intense smoke and heat generated by the rapid fire spread would have penetrated into the lift lobbies through the openable section of the windows, significantly hindering evacuation efforts.
